hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command'); echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $cmd" >> ~/.claude/bash-log.txt; if echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'git push'; then echo 'Running mvn test before push...'; mvn test; if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "Tests failed. Push blocked."}'; fi; fi
input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); if echo "$file" | grep -q '\.java$'; then mvn formatter:format -q 2>/dev/null || true; fi
input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); if echo "$file" | grep -q '\.java$'; then mvn checkstyle:check 2>&1 | grep -E '\[ERROR\]|\[WARN\]' || true; fi
